name: Car Track
description: Design printable track for 1:64 die-cast cars (the orange Hot Wheels-style channel): straights, curves, ramps and loops that chain end to end, connectors, supports, Split to fit for your printer, and a Test drive that runs a car over the track. Joins track you already own: measure it with calipers, print the fit test coupon, and use an adapter piece and anchors to meet a shop-bought set exactly. Install 3D Print as well to download the pieces.
author: MatthiasDM
